Definition: of Hebrew origin (H8004); Salem (i.e. Shalem), a place in Palestine:--Salem.
BiblicalUsage: Salem is a place in Palestine, the Salem of Melchizedek. You find the name in Hebrews 7:1, "…the most high God, who met Abraham returning…", and again in Hebrews 7:2.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Salem matters because God marks the places of his story, one by one. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
